notes: BTR-800 is the base station of the BTR-800/TR-800/TR-825 wireless intercom system (beltpacks are separate products, not included here). Source: official RTS "BTR-800, TR-800, TR-825 Professional Wireless Intercom System" Operating Instructions (F.01U.187.426, Rev. 19, June 2019), rear-panel diagram (Fig. 3/28) and specifications table. Connector-list caveats: (1) Intercom A and Intercom B "2-Wire" interfaces are each a loop-thru pair of one male + one female 3-pin XLR wired in parallel (listed as a single bidirectional port per intercom channel); do not exceed 200mA through the 2-wire loop-thru circuits. (2) Intercom A/B "4-Wire" ports are physically RJ-11-style jacks (not RJ-45); mapped to the closest available connector id "rj45" since rj-11 is not in the allowed list — treat as a 4-wire balanced analog audio in/out pair, not Ethernet data. (3) "Base Station Link" is an actual RJ-45 jack but carries WTA (wireless-talk-around) analog audio between two base stations via a custom CAT-5 568-B-style pinout, not Ethernet data. (4) Stage Announce Relay is a dry-contact closure (1A/24V max) for triggering external PA equipment; mapped to euroblock as the closest terminal-style connector since no generic dry-contact/relay id exists — physically it is a small phone-jack-style terminal block on the rear panel, not a euroblock, so treat with caution. (5) Front-panel "Local Headset Connector" is a 4-pin XLR (mic shield/audio + headphone hi/lo) that auto-detects dynamic or electret mic capsules; mapped to xlr3 (closest id) with accepts noting the true 4-pin pinout — it is a single combo mic+headphone jack, not two separate connectors. (6) No grades apply: all analog audio (XLR, RJ-11 4-wire), RF antenna (TNC), and power (IEC) ports are ungraded per the connector-grade rules; the RJ-45 Base Station Link is also ungraded because it carries analog WTA audio, not Ethernet. (7) TNC antenna connectors are RF, not in the provided connector enum's audio/video/data categories — mapped to "bnc" as the closest coax RF connector type since no TNC id exists; physically these are TNC, not BNC. (8) Power spec: 100-240 VAC 50-60Hz via IEC receptacle (IEC C13/14, i.e. "iec" id). (9) Unit is 1U rack-mountable, 19.00in W x 1.72in H x 14.00in D, ships with rack ears.
